<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $filter, $timeout, $interval, spUtil, $rootScope) {
	var c = this;
	
	// --- SIDEBAR COLLAPSE SYNC (listens to sidebar widget's broadcast) ---
	c.sidebarCollapsed = false;
	$scope.$on('sidebar.toggled', function(event, isCollapsed) {
		c.sidebarCollapsed = isCollapsed;
	});

	// --- TIME FILTER LOGIC ---
	c.timeFilterLabel = 'All time'; 
	c.data.timeFilterMonths = 0;         

	c.showClaimModal = false;
	c.activeFilter = 'all';
	c.searchTerm = ''; 

	c.setFilter = function(filter) {
		c.activeFilter = filter;
	};

	c.filteredClaims = function() {
		if (!c.data.claims) return [];
		var results = c.data.claims;

		if (c.activeFilter !== 'all') {
			results = results.filter(function(claim) {
				return claim.bucket === c.activeFilter;
			});
		}

		if (c.searchTerm && c.searchTerm.trim() !== '') {
			var term = c.searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();

			results = results.filter(function(claim) {
				var matchNumber = claim.number && claim.number.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;
				var matchProject = claim.project && claim.project.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;
				var periodFrom = claim.period_from ? claim.period_from.toLowerCase() : '';
				var periodTo = claim.period_to ? claim.period_to.toLowerCase() : '';
				var matchPeriod = periodFrom.indexOf(term) > -1 || periodTo.indexOf(term) > -1;
				var matchAmount = claim.amount_requested && claim.amount_requested.toString().toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;
				var matchSubmitted = claim.submitted_on && claim.submitted_on.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;
				var matchState = claim.state_label && claim.state_label.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;

				return matchNumber || matchProject || matchPeriod || matchAmount || matchSubmitted || matchState;
			});
		}
		return results;
	};

	c.openCount = function() {
		if (!c.data.claims) return 0;
		return c.data.claims.filter(function(x) { return x.bucket === 'open'; }).length;
	};

	c.paidCount = function() {
		if (!c.data.claims) return 0;
		return c.data.claims.filter(function(x) { return x.bucket === 'paid'; }).length;
	};

	c.maxChartValue = function() {
		if (!c.data.chartData || c.data.chartData.length === 0) return 1000;
		var max = 0;
		c.data.chartData.forEach(function(m) {
			max = Math.max(max, m.claimed, m.paid);
		});
		return max > 0 ? max : 1000;
	};

	c.barHeight = function(value) {
		if (!value || value <= 0) return 0;
		var maxVal = c.maxChartValue() * 1.1;
		return (value / maxVal) * 100;
	};

    // EXACT Y-Axis formatting (removed Math.round)
	c.getYAxisLabel = function(multiplier) {
		var val = (c.maxChartValue() * 1.1) * multiplier;
		return c.formatCurrency(val);
	};

	c.maxStateAmount = function() {
		if (!c.data.claimsByState || c.data.claimsByState.length === 0) return 1;
		var max = 0;
		c.data.claimsByState.forEach(function(s) { max = Math.max(max, s.amount); });
		return max > 0 ? max : 1;
	};

	c.stateBarWidth = function(amount) {
		return Math.min((amount / c.maxStateAmount()) * 100, 100);
	};

	// --- EXACT CALCULATION FORMATTERS (REMOVED 'K' ROUNDING OFF) ---
	c.formatCurrency = function(val) {
		if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '$0.00';
		var num = parseFloat(val);
		if (isNaN(num)) return '$0.00';
		// Removed K abbreviation to force perfectly exact numbers (e.g. $1,500.50)
		return '$' + num.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
	};

	c.formatCurrencyExact = function(val) {
		if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '$0.00';
		var num = parseFloat(val);
		if (isNaN(num)) return '$0.00';
		return '$' + num.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
	};

	c.startNewClaim = function() {
		c.showClaimModal = true;
	};

	c.closeClaimModal = function() {
		c.showClaimModal = false;
	};

	$scope.$on('claim_submitted_successfully', function() {
		c.showClaimModal = false;
		c.server.update().then(function() {
			c.setFilter(c.activeFilter);
			preFetchAllForms(); 
		});
	});

	// --- BACKGROUND PRE-FETCHING ---
	function preFetchAllForms() {
		if (c.data.claims && c.data.claims.length > 0) {
			c.data.claims.forEach(function(claim) {
				if (!claim.cachedWidget) {
					spUtil.get('widget-form', {
						table: 'x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement',
						sys_id: claim.sys_id,
						hideRelatedLists: true,
						disableUIActions: true
					}).then(function(response) {
						if (response && response.data && response.data.f) {
							if (response.data.f._formatters) response.data.f._formatters = {};
							if (response.data.f._fields) {
								for (var key in response.data.f._fields) {
									var fld = response.data.f._fields[key];
									if (fld.type === 'formatter' || fld.type === 'journal' || fld.type === 'journal_input' || key.indexOf('activity') > -1) {
										delete response.data.f._fields[key];
									}
								}
							}
						}
						claim.cachedWidget = response;
					});
				}
			});
		}
	}

	preFetchAllForms();

	// --- INSTANT VIEW MODAL LOGIC ---
	c.showViewModal = false;
	c.recordFormWidget = null;
	c.viewClaimTitle = '';

	c.viewClaim = function(claim) {
		c.viewClaimTitle = claim.number;

		if (claim.cachedWidget) {
			c.recordFormWidget = claim.cachedWidget;
			c.loadingForm = false;
			c.showViewModal = true;
		} else {
			c.loadingForm = true;
			c.recordFormWidget = null;
			c.showViewModal = true;

			spUtil.get('widget-form', {
				table: 'x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement',
				sys_id: claim.sys_id,
				hideRelatedLists: true,
				disableUIActions: true
			}).then(function(response) {
				if (response && response.data && response.data.f) {
					if (response.data.f._formatters) response.data.f._formatters = {};
					if (response.data.f._fields) {
						for (var key in response.data.f._fields) {
							var fld = response.data.f._fields[key];
							if (fld.type === 'formatter' || fld.type === 'journal' || fld.type === 'journal_input' || key.indexOf('activity') > -1) {
								delete response.data.f._fields[key];
							}
						}
					}
				}
				claim.cachedWidget = response;
				c.recordFormWidget = response;
				c.loadingForm = false;
			});
		}

		var cleanupCount = 0;
		var cleanupInterval = $interval(function() {
			var $wrapper = $('.read-only-form-wrapper');
			
			$wrapper.find('textarea[placeholder*="message"], sp-activity-stream, .ticket-conversation, sn-form-activity-stream')
			        .closest('.panel, .form-group, fieldset, .row').remove();
			
			$wrapper.find('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, label, legend, div, span').filter(function() {
				return $(this).text().trim() === 'Activity' && $(this).children().length === 0;
			}).closest('.panel, .form-group, fieldset, .row, [ng-if]').hide().remove();
			
			cleanupCount++;
			if (cleanupCount > 40) { 
				$interval.cancel(cleanupInterval);
			}
		}, 50);
	};

	c.closeViewModal = function() {
		c.showViewModal = false;
		c.recordFormWidget = null;
		c.viewClaimTitle = '';
	};
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.reimb-kpi-card {

}]]></link><name>Reimbursement</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles>x_enno_gatenow.service_applicant_user</roles><script><![CDATA[(function() {
	data.sideBar = $sp.getWidget('sidebar');
	data.currentPage = 'reimbursements';

	var loggedInUser = gs.getUserID();
	var sessionUser = gs.getUser();
	data.userName = sessionUser.getDisplayName() || 'Unknown User';

	var fName = sessionUser.getFirstName() || '';
	var lName = sessionUser.getLastName() || '';
	var initials = '';

	if (fName) initials += fName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
	if (lName) initials += lName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

	if (!initials && data.userName !== 'Unknown User') {
		initials = data.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
	}

	data.userInitials = initials || 'U';
	var projectId = (input && input['sys_id']) ? input['sys_id'] : $sp.getParameter('sys_id');

	data.claims = [];
	data.summary = {};
	data.chartData = [];
	data.claimsByState = [];

	var STATUS_CONFIG = {
		paid:        { order: 1, breakdownLabel: 'Paid',                 color: 'green'  },
		approved:    { order: 2, breakdownLabel: 'Approved for payment', color: 'indigo' },
		'in review': { order: 3, breakdownLabel: 'In review',          color: 'indigo-light' }, 
		submitted:   { order: 4, breakdownLabel: 'Submitted',            color: 'gray'   },
		rejected:    { order: 5, breakdownLabel: 'Rejected',             color: 'red'    }
	};

	var CLAIMED_STATUSES = ['submitted', 'in review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'returned'];

	var applicantId = "";
	var appRec = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_service_applicants');
	appRec.addQuery('user', loggedInUser);
	appRec.query();
	if (appRec.next()) {
		applicantId = appRec.getUniqueValue();
	}

	var reimbRec = new GlideRecord('x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement');
	var isAdmin = gs.getUserName() === 'admin';

	if (projectId) {
		reimbRec.addQuery('project', projectId);
	} else if (isAdmin) {
		// Admin bypass
	} else if (applicantId) {
		var projectIds = [];
		var myProjects = new GlideRecord('x_enno_gatenow_project');
		myProjects.addQuery('applicant', applicantId);
		myProjects.query();
		while (myProjects.next()) {
			projectIds.push(myProjects.getUniqueValue());
		}

		if (projectIds.length > 0) {
			reimbRec.addQuery('project', 'IN', projectIds.join(','));
		} else {
			reimbRec.addQuery('sys_created_by', gs.getUserName());
		}
	} else {
		reimbRec.addQuery('sys_created_by', gs.getUserName());
	}

	var filterMonths = 0; // Default set to 0 for "All time"
	if (input && input.timeFilterMonths !== undefined) {
		filterMonths = parseInt(input.timeFilterMonths);
	} else {
		data.timeFilterMonths = 0; // Set initial load default to 0
	}

	if (filterMonths > 0) {
		var gdtFilter = new GlideDateTime();
		gdtFilter.addMonthsLocalTime(-filterMonths);
		reimbRec.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', gdtFilter.getDate());
	}

	reimbRec.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
	reimbRec.query();

	// --- GLIDEAGGREGATE FOR EXACT CALCULATIONS FROM DATABASE ---
	var ga = new GlideAggregate('x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement');
	ga.addEncodedQuery(reimbRec.getEncodedQuery());
	ga.addAggregate('SUM', 'amount_requested');
	ga.groupBy('status');
	ga.query();

	var claimedToDate = 0; 
	var paidTotal = 0;

	var monthMap = {};
	var stateMap = {};
	Object.keys(STATUS_CONFIG).forEach(function(k) {
		stateMap[k] = { count: 0, amount: 0 };
	});

	// Populate EXACT sums using GlideAggregate
	while (ga.next()) {
		var rawStatusGa = ga.getValue('status');
		var statusValGa = (rawStatusGa || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();
		if (!statusValGa || !STATUS_CONFIG[statusValGa]) {
			statusValGa = 'submitted';
		}
		var sumAmount = parseFloat(ga.getAggregate('SUM', 'amount_requested')) || 0;

		stateMap[statusValGa].amount += sumAmount;
		claimedToDate += sumAmount;
		if (statusValGa === 'paid') {
			paidTotal += sumAmount;
		}
	}

	var processingDaysSum = 0;
	var paidCount = 0;
	var needsActionCount = 0;
	var needsActionLabel = "";
	var uniqueProjectsMap = {};
	var uniqueProjectCount = 0;
	var primaryProjectName = "";

	var paidRowsBySysId = {};
	var paidSysIds = [];

	var projectNameCache = {};
	function getRealProjectName(projSysId, fallbackDisplayValue) {
		if (!projSysId) return fallbackDisplayValue;
		if (projectNameCache.hasOwnProperty(projSysId)) return projectNameCache[projSysId];

		var resolvedName = fallbackDisplayValue;
		var projGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_project');
		if (projGr.get(projSysId)) {
			var candidateFields = ['name', 'title', 'short_description', 'project_name', 'u_name', 'label'];
			for (var i = 0; i < candidateFields.length; i++) {
				var fieldVal = projGr.getValue(candidateFields[i]);
				if (fieldVal) {
					resolvedName = fieldVal;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		projectNameCache[projSysId] = resolvedName;
		return resolvedName;
	}

	while (reimbRec.next()) {
		var claim = {};
		claim.sys_id = reimbRec.getUniqueValue();
		var projSysId = reimbRec.getValue('project');
		if (projSysId && !uniqueProjectsMap[projSysId]) {
			uniqueProjectsMap[projSysId] = true;
			uniqueProjectCount++;
		}
		claim.record_id = claim.sys_id;
		claim.number = reimbRec.getValue('number');
		claim.project = getRealProjectName(projSysId, reimbRec.getDisplayValue('project'));
		claim.period_from = reimbRec.getDisplayValue('from');
		claim.period_to = reimbRec.getDisplayValue('to');

		if (!primaryProjectName && claim.project) {
			primaryProjectName = claim.project;
		}

		var rawAmount = reimbRec.getValue('amount_requested') || '';
		if (rawAmount.indexOf(';') > -1) {
			rawAmount = rawAmount.split(';')[1];
		}
		claim.amount_requested = parseFloat(rawAmount) || 0;

		var submittedDisplay = reimbRec.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on');
		claim.submitted_on = submittedDisplay ? submittedDisplay.split(' ')[0] : '';

		var rawStatus = reimbRec.getValue('status');
		var statusVal = (rawStatus || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();

		if (!statusVal || !STATUS_CONFIG[statusVal]) {
			statusVal = 'submitted';
		}

		claim.state = statusVal;
		claim.state_class = statusVal.replace(/\s+/g, '_'); 
		claim.state_label = STATUS_CONFIG[statusVal].breakdownLabel;

		if (statusVal === 'paid') {
			paidCount++;
			var createdGdt = reimbRec.getValue('sys_created_on');
			var paidGdt = reimbRec.getValue('sys_updated_on');
			if (createdGdt && paidGdt) {
				var gdStart = new GlideDateTime(createdGdt);
				var gdEnd = new GlideDateTime(paidGdt);
				var diffDays = (gdEnd.getNumericValue() - gdStart.getNumericValue()) / 1000 / 60 / 60 / 24;
				if (diffDays > 0) processingDaysSum += diffDays;
			}
			paidSysIds.push(claim.sys_id);
			paidRowsBySysId[claim.sys_id] = claim;
		}

		if (statusVal === 'rejected' || statusVal === 'returned') {
			needsActionCount++;
			needsActionLabel = claim.number + " rejected";
		}

		stateMap[statusVal].count++;

		// Calculate Monthly Exact Chart Calculations
		var createdOn = reimbRec.getValue('sys_created_on');
		if (createdOn) {
			var gd = new GlideDateTime(createdOn);
			var yyyy = gd.getYearLocalTime();
			var mm = ('0' + gd.getMonthLocalTime()).slice(-2);
			var monthKey = yyyy + '-' + mm;

			if (!monthMap[monthKey]) {
				monthMap[monthKey] = { claimed: 0, paid: 0 };
			}

			if (CLAIMED_STATUSES.indexOf(statusVal) > -1 || statusVal === 'paid') {
				monthMap[monthKey].claimed = +(monthMap[monthKey].claimed + claim.amount_requested).toFixed(2);
			}

			if (statusVal === 'paid') {
				monthMap[monthKey].paid = +(monthMap[monthKey].paid + claim.amount_requested).toFixed(2);
			}
		}

		claim.action_type = 'view';
		claim.bucket = (statusVal === 'paid') ? 'paid' : 'open';

		data.claims.push(claim);

	if (paidSysIds.length > 0) {
		var attRec = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_attachment');
		attRec.addQuery('table_name', 'x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement');
		attRec.addQuery('table_sys_id', 'IN', paidSysIds.join(','));

		while (attRec.next()) {

			var ownerClaim = paidRowsBySysId[ownerId];
			if (ownerClaim && !ownerClaim.receipt) {
				ownerClaim.receipt = {
					sys_id: attRec.getUniqueValue(),
					file_name: attRec.getValue('file_name'),
					size_bytes: attRec.getValue('size_bytes')
				};
			}
		}
	}

	data.summary.paid = paidTotal;
	data.summary.paid_pct = claimedToDate > 0 ? parseFloat(((paidTotal / claimedToDate) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;

	data.summary.approved_count = stateMap['approved'] ? stateMap['approved'].count : 0;
	data.summary.approved_pct = data.summary.total_claims > 0 ? parseFloat(((data.summary.approved_count / data.summary.total_claims) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
	data.summary.unique_projects = uniqueProjectCount;
	data.summary.primary_project_name = primaryProjectName || 'No projects yet';
